_trace.why: The commit message claims nestingLevel scales with 'how many snippets need to be merged', but the code never uses others.length (the merge count) in the formula — it computes Math.max(8, ...others.map(...)) where each mapped value is either a nested snippet's own last placeholder index (only when its position i is less than the current placeholder group's length) or a constant 8, an unrelated and effectively arbitrary heuristic rather than a count-based nesting level. The integer-reindexing loop after changeDecorations does exist and plausibly reduces floating-point drift, but it also skips (never reassigns) the final-tabstop group via the early break, so that part's correctness is unverified.
